'''Aeldene Stonebridge''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]].

==Appearance==
She has a crooked nose that was said to have been gotten from fighting with her fists as a girl.

==Strength and Abilities==
Aeldene is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|33}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler. Siuan describes her as "no more than middling" in strength.{{ref/book|7|11}}

==History==
She is from the [[Mountains of Mist]] in [[Andor]].

She was a [[wilder]] and went to the [[White Tower]] at age twenty-four, but lied about her age. She had been a [[novice]] for five years when her lie was discovered. For that, she spent five more years in novice white. After those ten years, she spent nine as [[Accepted]] and was raised to the [[shawl]] at age forty-three.

She took over as the head of the [[eyes-and-ears]] of the Blue Ajah when [[Siuan Sanche]] was raised to [[Amyrlin]]. One of the agents that reported to her was [[Duranda Tharne]]. Only two or three women among the Blue Ajah were meant to know her identity; Siuan herself was unaware of her replacement.

==Activities==
She arrived in [[Salidar]] and demanded that Siuan gave back the eyes-and-ears network. Upon learning that Siuan had revealed her identity as head of eyes-and-ears to others, she flew into a rage. She publicly upbraided Siuan, shouted at her and nearly started a fight with her. 

She also attempted to pump out the identities of those agents working in the Amyrlin Seat's network, but the other Ajahs did not wanted the Blue Ajah having access to both networks, so Siuan retained that knowledge.
